run_normalize_stdin: run a Moses punctuation normalizer on stdin text with configurable language and Penn treebank mode
run_normalize_lang: run the normalizer with a custom language code via the --lang flag for non-English text
run_normalize_penn: run the normalizer with Penn treebank punctuation normalization enabled using the --penn flag
review_main_normalizer: review the main function that creates a MosesPunctNormalizer and normalizes each line from stdin
summarize_normalize_script: summarize the CLI script that normalizes punctuation in text using sacremoses MosesPunctNormalizer
